analysis:
Examined the complete supplied BASE file (lines 1–874) and bounded patch. The change replaces planner-wide discovery-mode selection with per-artifact readAutomatic calls receiving mtpMode and coordinator (BASE lines 563–565, 616–625). Its stated effect is to permit a build-declared public speculative assistant in coordinator-serving plans, rather than always quoting the ordinary target. No independently supported regression is visible: the assistant admission implementation and complete HEAD calls are not supplied, and the pre-existing explicit tensorAssistants override at BASE lines 608–614 is not a new bypass.
Cross-file review must verify ClusterPlacementTensorAssistantSelection.discoveryMode/readAutomatic enforce the exact public artifact/build allowlist for coordinator serving, including widening quotes, and that downstream configuration/runtime admission binds both target and assistant artifacts. Relevant contracts are model integrity and output correctness (A-004, T-007, T-012, T-027), build qualification/serving authorization (A-016, A-017, T-052–T-056), and memory availability (A-018). In this file, capability is rechecked before saving/delivering setup (BASE lines 704–718); that alone does not establish assistant qualification. Also reconcile assistant quotes with ordinary-target fallback (630–636) and retained generation modes (652–658).
Surrounding pairing, pinned link/SSH transport, owner-only setup files, local bearer-authenticated test prompts, and report paths were examined. The visible edits do not directly change encryption, token custody, billing, prefix-cache scoping/storage (T-041), attestation, or logout. Missing helper/runtime evidence remains a coverage limit; further integration review is needed to resolve the new public-assistant admission contract, not to presume a vulnerability.
